Figure 61 Comparison of Exam Scores 
The comparison of exam scores as shown in Figure 61, reveals a clear 
divergence of exam scores between the groups. The total score for the proposed 
application stands at 43, with an average of 4.3 per student; indicating that 
student tended to have a solid grasp of the content’s materials. While Bitesize 
users have a total score of 25; this score maybe miss leading because one 
student missing data, making a direct comparison less suitable. An average 
score among the users will remove this discrepancy, thus Bitesize users average 
score was 2.78. Thus, the proposed application showed a 54.68% improvement 
over Bitesize.
